newsitem.title: NORWAY: Storebrand surges in huge trade.
newsitem.headline: Storebrand surges in huge trade.

text.p: Shares in Norway's largest insurance group Storebrand ASA surged almost five percent on Friday in huge trade of almost 20 million shares.

Brokers said fund manager Tiger Management has sold a block of 18.5 million shares to fulfil a ruling by the Finance Ministry that the group must reduce its shareholding to 10 percent before year end in accordance with Norwegian securities regulations.
"Rumours are that Tiger have sold down in shares but have ploughed into options and that has made the share rise," said one broker.
At 1143 GMT Storebrand was 1.50 crowns up at 36.50 cropwns, having traded to a high at 36.70 crowns.
Food and beverage-based conglomerate has also been told to reduce its shareholding in Storebrand.
